title: The Zero-G Stampede
logline: A cattle freighter captain suspects a livestock speculator hacked his artificial gravity coils to cause a stampede in the hold, forcing the crew to jettison the herd so meat futures soar.

roles.description: Skipper of an ungainly bulk livestock freighter; smelling of manure, stubborn, wrestling a failing ship through chaotic cattle stampedes.
An aggressive meat futures arbitrageur; ruthless, dressed in tailored silk, holding massive long options on frozen beef.
A high-speed raider skiff deployed to shadow the cattle hauler and jam distress transmissions.
The union of independent livestock haulers who transport live herds between orbital agriculture domes.
The processing consortium that owns the station abattoirs and wholesale protein distribution channels.
A battered, multi-decked bulk hauler holding two thousand bellowing cattle in tumbling zero-g pens.
The pressurized orbital feedlots where herds are quarantined and inspected before processing.

public_situation: Emergency sirens sound as {role:cattle_transport} tumbles off station approach vectors, its hold compromised by a violent interior livestock stampede.
private_truth: {role:meat_speculator} uploaded an oscillation pulse into the ship's artificial gravity drive to spook the herd and force the captain to jettison the livestock.

beats.public_change: Bellowing cattle and buckled hull plating are broadcast over station approach channels as the transport lists twenty degrees.

missions.reason: He needs structural ferrite delivered to the ventral loading ramp to weld emergency internal baffles before two thousand cows breach the outer hull.
missions.private_fact: His chief engineer was knocked unconscious by a flying heifer when the artificial gravity first flickered.

beats.public_change: The drover pulls diagnostic telemetry from the gravity engine, discovering an unauthorized sub-routine broadcast from a shadowing skiff.

missions.reason: He needs an independent scan of the ship's grav-drive transmitter logs to isolate the exact frequency key used to cycle the deck gravity.
missions.private_fact: He borrowed fifty thousand credits from the speculator's brother to finance this voyage's fodder supplies.

beats.public_change: Raider drones deploy from the shadowing skiff, firing EMP darts into the freighter's auxiliary thruster pods to prevent docking.

missions.reason: He needs the drone picket destroyed and the electronic transmitter controller recovered to prove the cattle stampede was manufactured.
missions.private_fact: The freighter's hold airlocks are currently tied off with cargo straps and could give way at any second.

beats.public_change: {role:speculator_skiff} maneuvers into the approach lane between the freighter and {role:intake_stockyards}, preparing boarding cables.

missions.reason: He needs the speculator's ship disabled so the herd can be guided into the stockyard docking slipway intact.
missions.private_fact: The speculator hails mid-fight offering forty percent of his meat futures profits if the pilot forces the drover to blow the cargo hatches.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the skiff and guides the cattle hauler to port.
resolutions.summary: Two thousand cattle are safely unloaded into {role:intake_stockyards}. {role:meat_speculator} faces fraud and sabotage charges, and meat prices stabilize.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary broke through raider skiffs to help an exhausted drover dock two thousand stampeding cows in zero gravity.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers an emergency docking clearance under distressed cargo terms, or the gravity drive burns out.
resolutions.summary: The herd is docked without jettison, but {role:packing_cartel} levies heavy salvage penalty deductions, leaving {role:livestock_drover} deep in debt.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the speculator's cut or the hull gives way.
resolutions.summary: The cargo doors are blown, venting two thousand head of cattle into space. Meat prices skyrocket, and {role:meat_speculator} reaps a fortune.

consequences.public_summary: Dark frontier ballads sing of a mercenary who took a bribe to let two thousand prize heifers be blown out an airlock to spike meat prices.

loose_threads.detail: The exchange board lists forward contracts for frozen meat surging three hundred percent, heavily purchased by the speculator's shell firm.
The grav-drive firmware contains an oscillator virus programmed with an encryption signature belonging to a cartel software broker.
The registration stencil on {role:speculator_skiff} conceals an older corporate security identification code from an adjacent sector.

radio_hooks: Port authority issues debris advisory around Berth Twelve citing 'tumbling livestock transport'.
Meat futures trade wildly on rumors of impending cargo loss on inner system approaches.
Drover guild spokesmen accuse commercial meatpackers of reckless predatory tactics.

voice_direction.livestock_drover: Loud, bellowing, and thoroughly unhinged. Constantly yells obscenities at errant cattle over the comms while trying to keep his ship from rolling into a station gantry.
voice_direction.meat_speculator: Polished, smooth, and coldly aristocratic. Speaks of orbital slaughter and economic strangulation with the effortless charm of a private banker enjoying vintage wine.
